say:1:1320708001:0.text: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.
say:1:1320708001:0.male: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.
say:1:1320708001:0.female: Look at that, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Teamwork makes the dream work! We finished in no time.

say:2:1320708002:1.text: Great job! But you don't think this measly work is enough to deserve something in return, do you?
say:2:1320708002:1.source_cn: 做得不错，但我这里永远不降价！

say:4:1320708004:1.text: Just kidding! You've been so helpful. This pack of candied fruit is on the house.
say:4:1320708004:1.source_cn: 不过……看在你们这么勤快的份上，这包果脯干脆送给你好了。

say:5:1320708005:1.text: Cedartown is a welcoming place, we don't let guests leave unhappy!
say:5:1320708005:1.source_cn: 我们雪松镇是好客的地方，不会让客人伤心离去的。

say:6:1320708006:1.text: Thank you! Since you've been so generous, I'll also help with your delivery! Where's it going?
say:6:1320708006:1.source_cn: 谢谢你！收了你的东西，我更得帮你干活了，你的货物要送哪去？

say:7:1320708007:1.text: To Fedor, the shepherd. He ordered a crate of crystalberries. You'll see his pen right outside town.
say:7:1320708007:1.source_cn: 费多尔，他是个牧羊人，找我订购了一箱冰晶莓。你出了镇子...

say:8:1320708008:1.text: Got it, I'll head out now!
